notes.title: Discord scammers pretend to be developers. Please be carefull.
notes.content:
Hi!

Sorry for this news, but while the game is no longer in development, someone is trying to use this page and our screenshots to send hacker links via Discord.

If you receive a message from the "developer" of this game and are asked to test the game, be careful - it's a scammer and your account may be hacked. Please report any susspissios accounts that try to do this.

Thank you
Alexey
